title: clear heart
body:
**This resource pack is a game-changer for players who want absolute clarity during intense combat or survival situations. It completely redesigns the status effect icons for withered, poisoned, and frozen hearts, alongside the standard blinking animation when taking damage. By making these indicators more distinct and high-contrast, you gain perfect control over your health pool, whether you are engaging in high-stakes PvP or navigating the dangerous corridors of a Nether Fortress. No more second-guessing your HP—stay focused, react faster, and survive longer with enhanced visual feedback.**

- **changes**
- **Poisoned/withered/frozen heart Texture**
- **remove's blinking**
